title: Thunderbay Bar
venue_description:
Thunderbay Bar - Tampa's Premier Neighborhood Music Venue

Thunderbay Bar has earned its reputation as one of Tampa's most beloved neighborhood venues winning Creative Loafing's Best of the Bay award for Best Neighborhood Bar in both 2024 and 2025. Located in the Carrollwood area this welcoming establishment combines great cocktails ice cold beer and consistent live entertainment in a friendly community atmosphere.

Live Music Programming

The bar showcases Tampa's local music talent with open jam and open mic nights every Monday and Tuesday from 5-10 PM hosted by musician Greg Norris. These sessions welcome musicians of all skill levels to bring their instruments borrow from the house collection or simply enjoy watching local talent collaborate on rock blues and jam band favorites. The supportive environment encourages both experienced performers and newcomers to share the stage.

In addition to jam sessions Thunderbay features karaoke dance parties on Wednesday Friday and Saturday nights creating a lively entertainment schedule throughout the week. The venue has become known for fostering a strong community spirit where regular patrons and performers feel like family.

Venue Amenities

Thunderbay features over 16 high-definition televisions making it an ideal spot for sports fans to catch NFL games and other sporting events. The bar offers outdoor seating pool tables for a dollar fifty per game dart boards and complimentary corn hole boards. With wheelchair accessibility and parking available in both front and back the venue ensures comfortable access for all guests.

Food and Drink

The bar serves a selection of pub fare and maintains reasonable drink prices despite inflation pressures. Bartenders are known for their friendly quick service and the overall atmosphere remains casual and welcoming perfect for unwinding after work or spending time with friends.

title: Pete's Place South
venue_description:
Pete's Place South - A Tampa Institution Since 1979

Pete's Place South has been a Tampa landmark for over 45 years serving the local community as a neighborhood bar with character. The recently renovated venue maintains its classic neighborhood feel while offering fresh updates that enhance the guest experience. Known throughout Tampa as having the cheapest drink specials every day Pete's Place attracts a diverse crowd of regulars and newcomers.

Musical Events

The venue hosts a Tuesday night open jam session from 8 PM to midnight led by musician Shawn Brown. These sessions provide a platform for local musicians to collaborate on rock blues and jam favorites with backline equipment available. The relaxed late-night format creates an ideal environment for extended musical exploration and community building among Tampa's music scene.

Pete's Place has earned recognition as the best karaoke spot in town with karaoke nights every Thursday Friday and Saturday. The combination of jam sessions and karaoke creates a venue that supports both traditional musicianship and participatory entertainment.

Food and Atmosphere

The menu features fresh Gulf grouper and gulf shrimp alongside classic bar fare. With 17 TVs and NFL ticket the venue caters to sports enthusiasts while maintaining distinct smoking and non-smoking areas for guest comfort. Additional entertainment includes dart boards and a jukebox contributing to the classic neighborhood bar atmosphere.

Community Connection

The staff at Pete's Place South is known for creating a welcoming environment where guests feel at home. The friendly bartenders attentive service and mix of older and younger patrons create a pleasant vibe that keeps people coming back. Regular events like Halloween parties with costume contests add to the community-oriented atmosphere though the venue maintains a lively but pleasant environment year-round.

title: Tom's Tavern Forest Hills
venue_description:
Tom's Tavern Forest Hills - Community Pub with Great Music

Tom's Tavern Forest Hills is a quintessential American pub that has become a beloved spot in Tampa's Forest Hills neighborhood. Previously known as Uncle Fats the venue has maintained its commitment to excellent food friendly service and live entertainment while updating its menu and enhancing its offerings.

Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday from 7-10 PM the tavern hosts an open mic night led by musician Fred Chandler. This long-running event has earned high praise for featuring great music in a safe friendly atmosphere. The open mic welcomes singers songwriters and musicians of all genres creating a supportive environment for performers to share their talents. The PA system is provided and the relaxed neighborhood setting encourages both experienced performers and first-timers to take the stage.

In addition to the Wednesday open mic the venue features live bands on select Friday and Saturday nights. A nice dance floor gets plenty of use during these performances creating an energetic atmosphere for music lovers.

Food and Drink

Tom's Tavern is particularly known for its wings which many patrons consider among the best in Tampa. The menu also features burgers chicken tenders fried pickles buffalo wings and other pub favorites with daily specials that enhance the already affordable offerings. Sides include options like fried potatoes and tater tots adding to the classic American pub fare selection.

Entertainment and Atmosphere

The tavern features multiple TVs for watching sports though staff occasionally face challenges with channel changes during big games. Pool tables provide additional entertainment and the venue maintains both indoor and outdoor seating areas. The atmosphere is family-friendly until 9 PM making it accessible for casual dinners earlier in the evening before transitioning to a more adult-oriented entertainment venue later at night.

With friendly staff who remember regular customers and their drink preferences Tom's Tavern creates a Cheers-like atmosphere where everyone feels welcome. The combination of quality food affordable prices and consistent live music has made it a fixture in Tampa's local music scene.

title: DI Coffee Bar
venue_description:
DI Coffee Bar - Davis Islands' Premier Jazz Destination

DI Coffee Bar has become a cornerstone of Tampa's jazz scene since opening on Davis Islands 11 years ago. Founded by Ramon Perez this vibrant coffee shop combines exceptional coffee all-day dining and a commitment to live music that has made it a beloved community gathering place.

Friday Night Jazz Series

The Friday Night Jazz series is the crown jewel of DI Coffee Bar's music programming having celebrated its second anniversary in October 2025. Every Friday from 7:30-10 PM the back patio transforms into an intimate jazz venue featuring guitarist Dominic Walker and a rotating cast of Tampa Bay's finest musicians including drummer Paul Gavin trumpeter James Suggs vocalist Bryan Hughes and bassist Jon Shea.

The performances feature mostly off-the-cuff standards and improvisation creating a spontaneous collaborative atmosphere. There's a five-dollar door charge at the back entrance and seating fills quickly so early arrival is recommended. The series has attracted both locals and travelers from across Tampa Bay who appreciate the high-quality musicianship in an informal setting. On occasion notable guest performers including Grammy-winning vocalist Samara Joy have dropped by to sit in with the house band.

Venue Atmosphere

The back patio features fire pits and space heaters ensuring year-round comfort for outdoor performances. In case of rain music moves inside to the cozy interior space. Both the indoor area and patio offer casual seating perfect for settling in with a bottle of wine or coffee while enjoying the music. The intimate setting creates a unique opportunity to experience world-class jazz up close.

Coffee and Food

DI Coffee Bar serves Miami-based Panther Coffee for all coffee drinks from cappuccinos to americanos and everything in between. The all-day menu features creative variations on the Cuban sandwich including the pesto Cuban and Caprese version alongside breakfast items like avocado toast and breakfast sandwiches. The coffee shop also offers a unique mix of retail items including beer wine candles and other curated products.

Expansion and Community Impact

The success of the Davis Islands location has led to plans for a second DI Coffee Bar in Seminole Heights at 6114 N Central Ave in the former Cake Cuties Bakery space. This expansion demonstrates the coffee shop's growing role in Tampa's cultural landscape and its commitment to bringing quality coffee and live music to more neighborhoods.

title: The Hangar Restaurant & Flight Lounge
venue_description:
The Hangar - Where Aviation Meets Jazz

The Hangar Restaurant & Flight Lounge occupies a unique position in Tampa Bay's music and dining scene. Located on the second floor of the Albert Whitted Airport in St. Petersburg the venue offers stunning views of the runway and Tampa Bay waterfront creating an unforgettable backdrop for dining and live music.

Monday Night Jazz Jam

The Monday Night Jazz Jam is The Hangar's signature music event having celebrated its 15th anniversary in 2025. Presented by the Al Downing Tampa Bay Jazz Association this free weekly event runs from 7-9 PM and has become Tampa Bay's most authentic jazz jam session. Hosted by trumpeter Dwayne White the jam features a seasoned house band including Stretch Bruyn on keyboard Kenny Walker on bass and Ron Gregg on drums.

The event welcomes musicians of all levels from seasoned professionals to high school students creating an educational and performance opportunity that embodies the spirit of jazz tradition. Musicians can register in advance or simply show up on the night and there's always room for players to share their talents with an enthusiastic audience. The jam focuses on New Orleans style jazz and standards while encouraging spontaneous collaborations and improvisation.

Notable guest artists frequently join the sessions and the Monday night tradition honors the long-standing jazz custom of musicians gathering on their night off to play music they love. The supportive atmosphere and quality of musicianship have made this event legendary in Tampa Bay's jazz community.

Additional Music Programming

In addition to the Monday jam sessions The Hangar features the Dwayne White Trio on Friday nights providing another opportunity for guests to enjoy live jazz while dining with views of planes taking off and landing.

Dining Experience

Executive Chef Matthew Smith creates daily specials that complement the regular menu featuring items like burgers meatloaf and pork chops. The restaurant serves breakfast lunch and dinner making it accessible throughout the day. While some guests find the food average others appreciate the unique aviation-themed atmosphere and quality service.

Location and Accessibility

The Hangar's location at Albert Whitted Airport places it adjacent to USF St. Petersburg Campus and near several major hospitals. The venue offers a truly distinctive dining experience where guests can watch helicopters banner planes and private aircraft take off and land while enjoying their meals and live music. This combination of aviation atmosphere quality music and waterfront views makes The Hangar a special destination in the Tampa Bay area.
